name: Comet
tagline: Perplexity's AI browser with a sidebar assistant that acts across your tabs.
description: An AI-native Chromium browser from Perplexity that puts a persistent assistant in the sidebar — it summarizes pages, compares products, and takes actions like drafting emails or managing tabs using the context of what you're browsing. Perplexity search is the default, with Deep Research and voice mode built in. Free on Windows, macOS, Android, and iOS; an optional $5/month Comet Plus tier unlocks premium publisher content.
insight: Launched July 2025 exclusively for $200/month Max subscribers; Perplexity made it free for everyone that October.

modelSupport.notes: Assistant runs on Perplexity's model lineup; frontier-model access follows your Perplexity subscription tier.

edge: The only major AI browser free across desktop and mobile, with an assistant that can act on open tabs, email, and calendar from the sidebar.
pros: Deep Research and voice built in
cons: Frontier models need Pro or Max

references.title: You no longer need to pay $200 to use Perplexity's Comet browser
Perplexity brings its AI browser Comet to Android
